Cancellation, expiry and failed verification discard the provisional connection without adding an account; existing accounts are preserved.
Accepted verified commits cannot be rolled back; a native-key write followed by account-file failure may leave an unreferenced private key, not an account entry.
Provider metadata checks require fresh authenticated evidence, not key presence or displayable quota. Claude native CLI status is authenticated configuration, not remote validity.

features.title: Forecast when each account runs out, whether a kind kept an account free, and the order to use them in
features.summary: The AI Accounts: Quota forecast view projects every account's binding window over seven days of six-hour cells at the current pace (runs out, locked until reset, new window), with a Table view and a detail of used versus even pace and recent daily use. Coverage replays five weeks of stored snapshots per provider kind and counts the work hours with no account of that kind free, continuing the current week on pace. Hand-off plans the coming week per kind: each hour goes to the free account that resets soonest, showing when to hand off and when the kind runs dry. Pace overlays every account's current window on one start-to-reset axis against even pace, with past windows for the selected account.
